name: Adzviser TikTok Shop
description:
Connect your TikTok Shop data to Claude. No more exporting CSVs or uploading files, Adzviser brings your reporting data directly into the conversation.

Ask about total orders, revenue, and items sold. Compare periods, dig into order status and fulfilment detail, and understand what's changed over time. Whether you're checking yesterday's sales or putting together a monthly report, start with a question and let Claude build the analysis you need.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adzviser TikTok Shop to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adzviser TikTok Shop to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://tiktok-shop.mcp.adzviser.com/http. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adzviser TikTok Shop MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser TikTok Shop provides these MCP tools: list_metrics_and_breakdowns_tiktok_shop, list_workspace, and retrieve_reporting_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Adzviser TikTok Shop?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Adzviser TikTok Shop in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Adzviser TikTok Shop MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser TikTok Shop requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Adzviser TikTok Shop is developed by Adzviser LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
